refundPolicy: All program enrollments are final and non-refundable once payment is made, except in the case of a verified duplicate payment or an excess amount charged due to a technical error — such cases must be reported within 7 days of the transaction with proof of payment.
placementPolicy: Sraventix provides genuine placement support — resume building, mock interviews, and connections to its hiring-partner network. Sraventix does not guarantee jobs or internships. Any advertisement, agent, or individual promising a guaranteed job or internship on behalf of Sraventix is unauthorized and should be reported immediately.
paymentSafety: Sraventix never asks for a deposit for placement support, referrals, or interviews beyond the program fee. Do not pay anyone demanding such a payment in Sraventix's name.
privacy: Personal data such as name, email, and enrollment details is used only to deliver services, communicate with learners, issue certificates, and provide placement support. Sraventix does not sell personal data.
